geeklist.title: BGG Spring 2025 Virtual Flea Market (VFM) **CLOSED**
geeklist.description:
[bgcolor=#e22400][size=24]***CLOSED***[/size][/bgcolor] Hey Everyone!!
The Time has come for the BGG.Spring 2025 Virtual Flea Market (VFM)! I will be working with Mark to host the event this year. You must be an attendee (or have a proxy attendee) of BGG Con Spring 2025 to pick up and exchange items at this event.
[b]If you are new to the VFM or unsure of something please, please read the general information posted as Item number 1 in this geek list. [/b] It should hopefully answer any questions and if not comment on the item and people will gladly help.
Main information Where: Innovation Ballroom When: Friday May 23rd 8pm Sellers: 7pm -7:50 [b]ALL SELLERS MUST BE INSIDE NO LATER THAN 7:50pm.[/b] Buyers: 8pm - 9pm
[imageid=8888108 large] [imageid=8890515 large]
[b]REMEMBER DO NOT DELETE YOUR LISTINGS[/b]
[b][u]Links:[/u][/b] [geeklist=355631]BGG Spring 2025 VFM Request List[/geeklist] [url=https://yulgame.com/Vfm/AddItems/355629]Bulk Adding Games to Geeklist[/url] (*This is an easy way to bulk add items to the geeklist) [i]Courtesy of Eric Bettan (Carnage994)[/i] [url=https://yulgame.com/Vfm/Items/355629]BGG Spring VFM 2025 Sortable List[/url]
[b]Note:[/b] the sortable list does make use of the MARK SOLD Button Below your item's picture
geeklist.comment: Hooray! It's begun.

I have a geeklist auction utility that all are invited to use. It helps with sorting, filtering, and reviewing listings. It's https://bgg.honormountain.co/.
If you give it a try let me know what you think, I'm making small incremental changes to it when I can.
Some features I built it for were sorting and filtering by multiple criteria (thank you AGGrid), filtering by wishlist, quickly checking the listing summary and comments without loading the BGG Geeklist page, and checking the average price paid in the geekmarket for that game.
Thanks Trey Barker for putting this together! 🙂

For a quick tip - I have seen folks say that Zelle is an accepted mode of payment. Zelle, as a stand-alone app, was discontinued in April. You have to establish a Zelle link within your banking app. Just thought I would mention it in case folks weren't aware, and don't want to be surprised on the day of. 🙂

[q="jmangus"]Photos of a Stagetop rotating game table that I am currently working on.
[/q]
How realistic would it be to print a 48 by 96 inch table topper using StateTop system?

Totally possible. However, it tends to get a little unstable when you exceed 32”. As long as it is sitting on a solid surface it would work perfectly though.
Gameframe might be a better option if you have a table where you intend to leave this set up. I am printing a gameframe for a 34x96 table in my game room right now as well. (Printed one piece so far. Many more pieces to go). Takes a lot less filament because it just builds the raised rails around the table which are fully customizable for dice, cards, chits, cup holders, etc.

Yeah, look into your options. Some have more details, some are more structured for larger stuff, etc. There's some really cool designwork too if you want to put the extra time in or happen to have a multi-color printer.
I do. I run a Bambu X1C with AMS. The single color is due to getting a great deal on PETG filament so I purchased several cases of the same color.

[q="jmangus"]Totally possible. However, it tends to get a little unstable when you exceed 32”. As long as it is sitting on a solid surface it would work perfectly though.
Gameframe might be a better option if you have a table where you intend to leave this set up. I am printing a gameframe for a 34x96 table in my game room right now as well. (Printed one piece so far. Many more pieces to go). Takes a lot less filament because it just builds the raised rails around the table which are fully customizable for dice, cards, chits, cup holders, etc. [/q]
Yep it would be solid on a a surface, nothing hanging over without support. Gotcha, yep the benefit for me would be to put it away. My game room is the size of a two car garage, but I love to use two folding table with a mat on top (48 * 96) when I play games, so I can put it away, to play VR or to play with kids, build forts etc. A table top that I can break down would be ideal. Looking for maybe a foldable wood solution that I could outsource to a local woodworker. Downside to 3d print, it seems it would take a ton of filament plus time to print. I do like the modularity though.
Would you use pla for everything or something different for rails?

PETG is my preferred filament for this, but PLA would work fine. I’ve been using Creality PETG and it makes beautiful prints. PLA tends to show more lines but you can’t run PETG unless your printer is enclosed.
I’ve been buying the Creality PETG by the case. 10 spools of filament for $104 shipped and have been very happy with it. However, each person has their own preference.
I think someone deleted 1 item

[q="jmangus"]PETG is my preferred filament for this, but PLA would work fine. I’ve been using Creality PETG and it makes beautiful prints. PLA tends to show more lines but you can’t run PETG unless your printer is enclosed.
I’ve been buying the Creality PETG by the case. 10 spools of filament for $104 shipped and have been very happy with it. However, each person has their own preference. [/q] I have been 3d printing for 10 years or so, but I have never used anything other than PLA. Why petg needs to be enclosed? Fumes or temperature control? I have bambu p1s right now, so it is enclosed, but its also in my garage so fumes are not a concern.

[q="never_play_with_gray"][q="jmangus"]PETG is my preferred filament for this, but PLA would work fine. I’ve been using Creality PETG and it makes beautiful prints. PLA tends to show more lines but you can’t run PETG unless your printer is enclosed.
I’ve been buying the Creality PETG by the case. 10 spools of filament for $104 shipped and have been very happy with it. However, each person has their own preference. [/q] I have been 3d printing for 10 years or so, but I have never used anything other than PLA. Why petg needs to be enclosed? Fumes or temperature control? I have bambu p1s right now, so it is enclosed, but its also in my garage so fumes are not a concern.[/q]
No fumes. Just temperature control. The Bambu P1S has an excellent profile for PETG. Prints very smoothly. I prefer it because it has more elasticity than PLA. If you drop PLA, it cracks. pETG doesn’t crack if dropped.

[q="Barkerware"]Hey folks, just a friendly reminder that if your listing is set up as AUCTION to please add an END DATE to the listing. May 15th is when I’m pulling numbers for tables. [/q]
First time at BGG Spring. What does this mean “pulling numbers for tables”?

[q="SoBoardTogether"][q="Barkerware"]Hey folks, just a friendly reminder that if your listing is set up as AUCTION to please add an END DATE to the listing. May 15th is when I’m pulling numbers for tables. [/q]
First time at BGG Spring. What does this mean “pulling numbers for tables”? [/q]
Tables will be allocated to sellers based on how many games they have sold. If you have auctions that close after May 15, you will not have marked them as sold at that point, so the true number of sales you have made will not be reflected in the count to allocate tables. This means you may end up with less space than you ideally need. If you change the dates for the end of your auction items and close out those sales by May 15, the count will be accurate.

Is this a good description to share with others? Someone wanted a simple explanation of the VFM and how to use this resource.
[q=Zafin]The virtual flea market is a place where people can list their games for sale and buy games for sale. It’s an online place for people to make their deals ahead of time and meetup to exchange games at the convention. If you sell at least 10-15 or so games you’ll get to share a table. If you sell typically 60 or more games you get your own table. You can’t bring a fold up table and set up shop at the event.
The virtual flea market which uses a GeekList and deals are done ahead of time with a meetup at the convention. The [b]VFM meetup[/b] is usually on Friday night. Then there’s also the [b]Bazaar[/b] where people set up tables and sell on the spot. The Bazaar is usually on Saturday morning.
So maybe these instructions will help you?
Instructions on how to add or bid on games on BoardGameGeek:
1. How to Add a Game for Sale to the Virtual Flea Market GeekList Listing
• You must have registered with BoardGameGeek.com to list your games.
• Below the VFM header click on “Add Item”. Note it looks like a “Plus Sign” ➕.
• Then select “Board Game”.
• A text section will be added.
• Enter the name of your board game below where it states: “Enter Board Game:”
• The game image ID will automatically be generated.
Note: You can change the image if you click on the magnifying glass.
• Type in the description of your game and please include: Price, General Condition, Shipping Availability, Available for Pickup at the VFM or outside the VFM, Your General Location in DFW, Payments types accepted like Cash, PayPal, Venmo, etc.
• Check the boxes for “Subscribe to this Geeklist” to get notifications on all games/comments AND/OR “Subscribe to just this Geeklist” if you want to get notifications for comments on your game.
• Click on “Save” at the bottom of the page to post your game.
----------- 2. How to Bid/Buy on a Game on the Virtual Flea Market GeekList Listing
• You must have registered with BoardGameGeek.com to bid on games.
• Below the game name and description click on “Comment”.
• Type in your offer in the new field below the game name and description.
• Check the box for notifications on this game by clicking “Subscribe to just this Geeklist Item.”
• Alternatively, if you want to be notified of all activity on the VFM Geeklist click on box for “Subscribe to Geeklist”.
• Click on “Save” at the bottom of the page to post your comment.
• The general default no shipping. If you want to buy a game and have it shipped please make sure the seller is open to shipping ahead of time.[/q]

How do you make it so that on the searchable list it has the "+expansion names" text under the listing title?

[q="galin54"]How do you make it so that on the searchable list it has the "+expansion names" text under the listing title?[/q] You need to link to the item in your post. For example, in your Elder Sign listing, you mention a bunch of expansions. If you instead mention them using the link tags like this:
Includes the following expansions: [thing=166679][/thing] [thing=137479][/thing] [thing=189807][/thing] [thing=198045][/thing]
Quote the post and you'll see how it works. I believe that will let the "yulgames" process properly detect and list your expansions.

As a side benefit it makes it easier for those browsing the listing to check out the expansions, if they're not familiar with them :)

Here is a link to the charity's site: https://www.catalystmentor.org/
There are 3 ways to help:
If you wish to donate any games (that you think would be good and suitable for ages 13 to 20 years old and not damaged or missing parts), feel free to do so. I will have a bin for that as well.
If you would like to become a volunteer mentor for teenagers let me know and we can coordinate the experience. It has been a very fulfilling experience for me and the other 80 to 100 mentors we have each year.
Alternatively, if you are ever looking for high school unpaid interns (and yes, they will work for free (remotely)), let me know as well. We have several high aptitude students who are often times willing to commit a year or more (typically 10 hours a week) to gain real-world experience.

item.body:
[b][size=24]BASIC INFORMATION AND RULES[/size][/b]
[u][i][size=18]Event Tickets[/size][/i][/u] There is no longer a TTE ticket requirement for this event.
Buyers/Sellers can claim at ticket on TTE to help them remember the place and time but it is not required.
[i][u][size=18]General[/size][/u][/i] The primary purpose of the Virtual Flea Market is to arrange the selling of games before arrival at the convention to be exchanged at the convention. This is not a local dallas flea market, listing items for sale with local pickup as the only option for getting the games is not the purpose of this list. You can certainly offer local pickup but you need to be able to bring your games to bgg con or have someone else do it in order to participate in the BGG Con VFM.
Please include the condition of your item and the price you'd like to sell for. Then you will simply swap the game for payment at the meetup with the buyer.
The in person event is not a sales event simply an exchange of deals made on this geeklist beforehand. Please do not try and set up a sales table (had a person do that in once), if you are looking to set up an in person sales table you are looking for the awesome BGG Bazaar.
If you are having a problem with keeping track of your items subscribe to the items you bid on and are selling. Then you can edit the geeklist settings to turn off comments so you only see comments on things you are subscribed to. Helps keep track of things a lot.
[i][u][size=18]Guidelines[/size][/u][/i] How you sell your items is up to you! Fixed Price, Auction, Dutch Auction, it doesn't matter. Everyone is on their own - no one will be monitoring your items but you. If you are running an auction, please be sure to define how that auction is going to run, particularly how/when it is going to end NOTE: please make sure your auction ends before May 15th as it will not count as a sale if it isn't marked sold before the 15th.
The main thing to always keep in mind is to be please be polite. Some buyers will make potentially lowball offers. Some sellers won't be interested in making deals.
[i][u][size=18]Delivery Meetup[/size][/u][/i] As in the past, we have a reserved time and space at BGG.Con Spring to make the swaps in the Innovation Ballroom on Friday May 23rd at 8pm.
Sellers will be allowed to enter starting at 7pm in order to setup. Current plan if for sellers to enter from Innovation D. Sellers will not be admitted after 7:50. If you are unable to obtain a seller's table, you must make other arrangements for swapping your games. If you are not going to be able to be at the swap, you need to note this in the item description. By participating in the VFM list as a seller and obtaining a seller's table you are agreeing to arrive early to set up. You may bring one helper with you to help out at your table. Sellers are expected to remain at their table until all items are sold. Based on 2023 numbers, there should be enough tables for anyone that sells more than 6 items. If you sell fewer than 6 we might be able to combine some tables but do not expect it. You or your helper are expected to be at your table for the entire duration of the VFM until you do not have anything left to sell.
Buyers are free to line up during this setup time but are not permitted inside yet. If you both buy and sell, you will need someone to pick up or be at your table as again someone must be at your table during the entirety of the VFM do not leave it unattended. Buyers will be able to enter from 8 PM.
PLEASE BE PROMPT! as both a Buyer and as a Seller no one wants to be stuck waiting around until 8:59 with 1 game left to trade or a buyer stuck waiting for a no show seller because you didn't want to leave your game early.
You are, of course, welcome to arrange other times/methods for your swaps on an individual basis (but see the note about an early meetup below).
Team Geek will be present overseeing the meetup. It is expected that all participants will cooperate fully with Team Geek.
[i][u][size=18]Delivery Meetup Room Plan[/size][/u][/i] In order to facilitate the meetup, tables will be assigned to sellers. Prior to the convention, the room plan will be posted in this header. Tables will be arranged in alphabetical order by user name. Tables will be labelled at the time of the meetup.
If you wish to pair up with someone please send me a geekmail.
[u][i][size=18]Unsold Game Filter Tools[/size][/i][/u] What is the sortable list? It's basically a dynamically updating listing of this geek list that lets you sort and filter rather than scroll through listings one by one. This way you can sort on a user, or on a letter, or look for a specific game. In addition you can use the bulk upload tool to list many games at once. As long as they are in your bgg collection and marked for trade it will create a listing for you that you can customize.
[url=https://yulgame.com/Vfm/Items/355629]BGG Spring VFM 2025 Sortable List[/url] [url=https://yulgame.com/Vfm/AddItems/355629]Bulk Adding Games to Geeklist[/url] (*This is an easy way to bulk add items to the Geeklist) [i]Courtesy of Eric Bettan (Carnage994)[/i]
In order for your games to better show up on this list the way you want to please follow the best practices below.
[u][i][size=18]Listing best practices[/size][/i][/u] These are some best practices for listing your items in the VFM they help with the listing tools and are just great ways to have people understand your listing. These will be updated with any tool specific requirements.
1. When your item sells, please use your Mark sold button directly below the picture of your game.
2. If your item is an auction, please include the word "Auction" someplace.
4. If you wish to remove an item from the summary list, add +remove+ in the game's entry. This tag takes precedence over everything else.
5. If you are selling an item that needs an alternate name in the summary list, please place this code in your item someplace: "+altname+ Whatever You'd Like To Call Your Item -altname-"
6. Please don't delete sold items!! Just leave them on the list. Thank you!
7. Please do not mark items as SOLD if they are not actually SOLD
[i][u][size=18]Request List[/size][/u][/i] If there is something you are looking for add it to the [geeklist=355631]BGG.Spring 2025 VFM Request List[/geeklist].
[i][u][size=18]Processing Payments[/size][/u][/i] Per BGG Guidelines, it is the seller's responsibility to process final sales through the BGG Marketplace. This may be facilitated by use of the sold button below each item's picture. Some people like to do a single lump sum payment for everything or for items where the buyer did not respond to the listing. In the past I have used a listing under Outside the Scope of BGG for this simply add the item on the geekmarket for the amount you need and mark it sold.
[i][u][size=18]Early Meetup[/size][/u][/i] In the past, some of the participants in the Fall VFM have tried to set up an early meetup on the night before the official start of the convention. This has been discouraged for several years now. While individuals getting together to make trades is certainly appropriate, please do not schedule a large-scale early meetup before the start of the convention.
Please do add your items! The more items, the more interest!
Please do not delete items once added. If an item is no longer available, please edit it to reflect that, but leave it in place. You can add +remove+ to the entry to keep it off the summary list.
[b][i][u][size=18]Additional tips for sellers and buyers:[/size][/u][/i][/b]
[u][i][size=18]Sellers:[/size][/i][/u] 1. Create a spreadsheet with the games your selling. Create columns for Game Name, Game Cost, Method of Payment, Buyer Name, Buyer BGG Name, Comments, etc. If you're paying via PayPal, Venmo, etc. make a note. Print off your list prior to the event and bring it with you.
2. Send out geek mails and confirm with the game sale with people who have bought games from you. Sometimes people miss responses to game transactions. Run your sales through BGG Marketplace either as a lot or individually so BGG can get their cut. It's only fair.
3. Have a full-length, printed sheet with your BGG User Name, Name, and Avatar/Logo on it for people to find you more easily.
4. Print out the table assignments beforehand. Circle your table.
5. Get there right at 7:00 pm to set up your games and table.
6. You must attend the whole hour or until all your games being sold are picked up by Buyers.
7. Team up with a friend (or a few friends) if you are both Buying and Selling games. You cannot be both a Buyer and Seller at the VFM event.
8. Removable Sticky notes on the game with the name of the Buyer picking up your games would be helpful.
9. Please get your money out of the envelopes and deposit the empty envelopes in the trash. Please do not leave it for staff to clean up!
10. Remember it's the most wonderful game time of the year! Be kind, courteous, and try to help others out as possible. This event is super fun!
[i][u][size=18]Buyers:[/size][/u][/i] 1. Create a spreadsheet with the games you're buying. Create columns for Game Name, Game Cost, Method of Payment, Seller Name, Seller BGG Name, Comments, etc. If you're paying via PayPal, Venmo, etc. make a note. Print off your list prior to the event and bring it with you.
2. Buy plain envelopes. Write down the name of each game you're buying and the BGG name of the Seller. Provide exact change. Put your name on your envelopes so it's easily identified as paid by sellers or in case it gets lost.
3. Get there around 7:45 pm and wait in line to get in. Buyers can't go in until 8:00 pm.
4. Bring plenty of bags to haul off your 'new' games. You may not be able to use the luggage carts.
5. Print out the table assignments beforehand. Circle or highlight the tables you need to visit.
6. Remember it's the most wonderful game time of the year! Be kind, courteous, and try to help others out as possible. This event is super fun!
There is a Virtual Flea Market microbadge [microbadge=40047] Get one and show your support for the VFM!
Still have questions/comments/concerns? Please comment on this item and people will be glad to help.
(if you want to help answer questions subscribe to this item)

Sorry all, I am a bit confused. The comments above I understand. But what does the below mean, first item on the rules. [i]Event Tickets There is no longer a TTE ticket requirement for this event. Buyers/Sellers can claim at ticket on TTE to help them remember the place and time but it is not required.[/i]
I have purchased a badge thru TTE, but I did not intend to participate in the CON part. Can you please clarify if we can be a Seller without the badge?
You have to purchase a BGG Spring badge. There is no separate ticket cost to attend the VFM.

[q="DaCubsFan"]Sorry all, I am a bit confused. The comments above I understand. But what does the below mean, first item on the rules. [i]Event Tickets There is no longer a TTE ticket requirement for this event. Buyers/Sellers can claim at ticket on TTE to help them remember the place and time but it is not required.[/i]
I have purchased a badge thru TTE, but I did not intend to participate in the CON part. Can you please clarify if we can be a Seller without the badge?[/q]
The VFM is for Convention attendees only (or if you have a proxy attendee) and must be present at the con during the VFM event. They use to use event tickets within TTE was used to keep account of how many were attending the event within the con, but the VFM is well enough established they no longer use them. This line of text is just a disclaimer that event tickets via TTE are no longer needed for this. But a Badge and attendance is still necessary as all transactions happen in person on site.

[B]Version:[/B] [B]Language:[/B] [B]Condition:[/B] New - [I]Comes with Clank! Legacy 2 and Kickstarter Promos. All new and still in shrink-wrap[/I] [B]BIN:[/B] [-]$180[/-] $160
[size=9][url=https://www.yulgame.com/Vfm/Items/355629?Seller=SwimmingScorpion&Status=NotSold]Click here to view all my items available for sale[/url][/size]
item.comment: I already have the first Clank! Legacy. Would you be willing to separate?

So, here's the situation: I got both as part of the KS for #2 because, at the time, I had thought that I was going to be moving apart from my roommate who was also getting both. That ended up not happening, so we played through their copies of both after they came in. Neither of us really feel like playing through the campaign for either again so now I'm stuck with 2 big boxes that I spent a bunch of money on. I've listed them for $180 to try to recover what I pledged for them, accepting that what I spent on shipping is just a loss for me. If I split them up and sell you #2 then I'm less likely to sell #1 and I have to figure out if/how I'm dividing the promo cards out since I know that some of them are only playable with #1 and some are only playable with #2. That's not a small amount of inconvenience on my end so if I do that then I'll need $120 for just number 2. I do understand your position of only actually needing #2 so I'm also willing to lower my price for the bundle down to $160. You'll have an extra copy of #1 that you'll have to get rid of but you'll only have to sell it for $40 to make up the difference between my bundle price and what I'm charging for just #2.

item.comment: Hi Mike, would you be able to do Long Shot for $8? If so, we have a deal!
I'll consider $8 the current bid, and if no one gets to $10 it is yours.
I'll take it for $10.
It is yours then FlubberDucky. I'll send you a geek mail with details

Hi Matt,
I thought this was mine for $8 per the email from Monday, May 19th? Let me know whats going on when you get a chance?

James, per above and the message on May 15, $8 was under the asking price, and what I said was, "I'll consider $8 the current bid, and if no one gets to $10 it is yours." Which I thought was pretty clear in the meaning, but since there is confusion I'll explain it here.
FlubberDucky offered the asking price which was $10, greater than your bid of $8 dollars, and so out bid you. Such is the risk you take when you do not meet the asking price,

Hi Mike,
On May 19th after you mentinoed you were going to wait, you wrote to me the following:
"I won't be at the BGG, but The Long Shot the Dice game will be, price: $8.
My friend Matt Stephans will have them for you as he is attending the convention. We will be at the flee market at the table for mstephans and his cell phone is 512-947-6288 in case it is needed. He has been given all the information and can reach me if needed.
You can pay him direct or electronically, or you can venmo me at:
https://venmo.com/u/Michael-Paolini-A
Cheers, Mike"
Initially you said you were going to wait, but then wrote that to me later.

Well, once again I'll point to the May 15 post stating if no one paid the asking price of $10 I'd sell it to you. On the 19th I sent you information in advance of the expected transaction reminding you of your bid and telling you where to meet because that is the custom since many people are traveling and do not have access to email or are too busy at the convention to check it - however, a bid just came in for the full asking price and the VFM was not closed, so you were out bid. I know that is disappointing, but it is also the risk you knowingly take when you choose to offer less than the asking price.

If you can tell me how I would know, I'll happily check. :-)

It would be in the copyright section. Usually in the back of the box near the upc. Sometimes the manual. On front or inside first page at the bottom. It usually shows an address, then a C with a circle around it and the company name with a year.
🙂 I will check the manual. My actual question is, "Is there a material difference?" Like is the gameplay changed or is there an error in the 2019 printing?
Looks like 2020, according to the manual.
To be honest I don't know the game enough to know, the few comments there are suggest there is a significant fix in the newer version. I'll take this though!

item.body: Condition: Used Includes: Promos, Neoprene Climate Mat, Box signed by game designer. Price: $30
item.comment: Hi Tony, would you be able to do this for $20? If so its a deal!

Hi, James. All my prices are pre-haggled. They are at or below prices I found online. When you factor in the promos, it's a great deal. I forgot to mention, the Climate game comes with a neoprene mat for the Climate board. I'll get that added.
What is the condition of Evolution: Climate?

It's in good condition. As far as I can tell, there is no damage to the box or components. This is the version with the nice, soft, score bags (instead of the later versions with the folded paper score screens). The dino meeple has the promo stickers on it (which are designed specifically to add color and patterns to to dino), and I've added some googly-eyes. The climate token has the stickers applied to it. The climate cards are penny-sleeved. The evolution cards, I've sorted into two groups. The majority group I've curated to be a full deck for 6 players with a bit more focus on player interaction (and Climate board interaction. These are sleeved in green cards. The second group are mostly promos or cards that have less player interaction. They are unsleeved. I've done this so you can customize your game as you like. I've also got some spare green sleeves in case the current ones go bad.
Also forgot to mention, the box is signed by the game designer.
Since you are buying Oceans already, I recommend taking a pause before buying Evolution. The games are pretty similar.
That's fine, I will take it for $30. I just wanted to make sure it was not damaged or missing any pieces.
SOLD. Thanks@ James T. I accept cash, PayPal, or Zelle.

A heavy-cardboard favorite for a reason...
I will not have a table inside the VFM. There are two ways we can seal the deal: 1. Enter the employee restroom behind the reception desk Saturday night at 9pm Zurich time. There you will be approached by a short, bearded man in a purple fez. In a thick Carpathian accent he will give you the challenge phrase “Mathilda’s thighs are very swollen.” You will give him the response “Yes, but is she not your cousin?” Having confirmed your identities you will hand him the money in large, marked bills and he will hand you the package. You will exchange clothes, and he will leave the restroom first; you will wait 10 minutes and do the same. Leave the purple fez at the front desk; that wasn’t part of the deal… Or 2. item.body:
This was the 1997 Spiel des Jarhe winner. German version but includes English rules.
Fun racing game where the object is to pick up Southern Belles as possible and then race at a leisurely unsafe speed into uncharted waters to get to the end of the map. There’s no mention in the rules of how the Belles, desperate and alone on their little islands for reasons unexplained, will compensate you when you get to the final dock. We had a blast giving them all names and making up backstories; but the gang I hang with are kind of weird that way…

[B]Version:[/B] [B]Language:[/B] [B]Condition:[/B] New - [I]New in Shrink I accept payments in advance via Zelle or Paypa
*****NON-PROFIT CHARITY****
Hi folks,
I know we don't know each other, but I work (as a volunteer) with an organization called Catalyst Collective (aka Purpose Project that also runs the Purpose Pro Podcast). You can look us up online at:
https://www.catalystmentor.org https://www.purposepro.org/podcast
We are a non-profit mentorship organization that works with underprivileged and at-risk teenagers and young-adults through Texas region and surrounding states (a network of 80 to 100 mentors servicing about 200 to 300 students each year). Our students are referred to us by counselors, juvenile judicial statf, and parents.
I help coordinate the game library and I saw another post from another non-profit, so I thought it wouldn't hurt to ask, if you have any games (in decent condition) after the Bazaar or Virtual Fair (or at any point on Friday, Saturday or Sunday) that you don't want and want to get rid of that are in decent condition, please hunt me down or message me here.
We offer our services for free to teenagers and young-adults and any donation is very much appreciated.
Thanks and look forward to meeting you at this year's BGG con (hit me up to play if you like - I enjoy just meeting people).
And if you like any of our games from the list (I dropped the prices just now on many of the games) and it will be used for a good cause.
Thanks,
James

****NON-PROFIT CHARITY****
Hi folks,
I know we don't know each other, but I work (as a volunteer) with an organization called Catalyst Collective (aka Purpose Project that also runs the Purpose Pro Podcast). You can look us up online at:
https://www.catalystmentor.org https://www.purposepro.org/podcast
We are a non-profit mentorship organization that works with underprivileged and at-risk teenagers and young-adults through Texas region and surrounding states (a network of 80 to 100 mentors servicing about 200 to 300 students each year). Our students are referred to us by counselors, juvenile judicial statf, and parents.
I help coordinate the game library and I saw another post from another non-profit, so I thought it wouldn't hurt to ask, if you have any games (in decent condition) after the Bazaar or Virtual Fair (or at any point on Friday, Saturday or Sunday) that you don't want and want to get rid of that are in decent condition, please hunt me down or message me here.
We offer our services for free to teenagers and young-adults and any donation is very much appreciated.

item.comment: Offer $25
Will pass but appreciate the offer.

$25 offer still stands if no one else pipes up. The forums say there can be issues with the playmat folding. How is it for your copy? If it's in good condition with no folding issues, then I don't see why I couldn't go up to $29 but, if there are, I'll sit at $25.

Hi Michael, mine is brand new, in shrink so I have no knowledge about any issues like it. I do have two copies (one for me) but I haven't opened it yet (as you can see from my sales list, I have a huge wall of shame 8-).
I like the IP and huge fan of the actor (I have Escape from New York as well as The Thing), but not selling those.
Anyway, I won't be dropping the price, but it sounds like you didn't know it was NIS and that may help.
Ah yeah, if it's in shrink, I'm ok going with $29. Sounds like it's kinda hit and miss with the folding anyway.

And if you like any of our games from the list (I dropped the prices just now on many of the games) and it will be used for a good cause.
Thanks,
James

And if you like any of our games from the list (I dropped the prices just now on many of the games) and it will be used for a good cause.

James

item.comment: Would you be willing to sell this for $30?

No, unfortunately, this the lowest we can go. I am working for a charity forcused on at-risk teens and can't go any lower (we did drop the price to the lowest we can go and will return it to the game library otherwise)
No worries. Just looked like one my 8yr old might enjoy and saw it on BGG marketplace for $35.

Yes, I saw that. The few differences are that the two that we are selling are New In Shrink and there are no shipping fees to have to pay (its a good size and weight box) and the one in BGG marketplace is "like new" and will require shipping fees. If you change your mind do not hesitate to let me know before we shut down the listing soon.

Understood. I was operating under the assumption that since you are selling so many new in shrink games they were likely donated. Shrink wrap doesn’t matter to me, I’m fine with used so it felt like a fair offer. Anyway, no worries. Offer withdrawn.

I completely understand and I hope you and your daughter enjoy the game from the BGG market (i am sure she will have a blast regardless of where it comes from).
See you at the Con.
James
Since this hasn’t sold and you’ve had no other offers, are you willing to compromise on the price?
Sold off market to someone who bought a bunch of the games outside of VFM

[B]Version:[/B] [B]Language:[/B] [B]Condition:[/B] New - [I]New in Shrink. Will accept Cash, Zelle or Paypal.
****NON-PROFIT DONATION****
Hi folks,
I know we don't know each other, but I work (as a volunteer) with an organization called Catalyst Collective (aka Purpose Project that also runs the Purpose Pro Podcast). You can look us up online at:
https://www.catalystmentor.org https://www.purposepro.org/podcast
We are a non-profit mentorship organization that works with underprivileged and at-risk teenagers and young-adults through Texas region and surrounding states (a network of 80 to 100 mentors servicing about 200 to 300 students each year). Our students are referred to us by counselors, juvenile judicial statf, and parents.
I help coordinate the game library and I saw another post from another non-profit, so I thought it wouldn't hurt to ask, if you have any games (in decent condition) after the Bazaar or Virtual Fair (or at any point on Friday, Saturday or Sunday) that you don't want and want to get rid of that are in decent condition, please hunt me down or message me here.
We offer our services for free to teenagers and young-adults and any donation is very much appreciated.
Thanks and look forward to meeting you at this year's BGG con (hit me up to play if you like - I enjoy just meeting people).
And if you like any of our games from the list (I dropped the prices just now on many of the games) and it will be used for a good cause.
Thanks,
James
